rationale: Shan leads robotics hardware and AI deployment at Ruyi Dynamics, while Prajyot is an ML/Robotics engineer at Meta with deep expertise in sim-to-real pipelines, manipulation, and mobile robotics. They both work across embodied AI and computer vision, and could explore how Meta's simulation and learning frameworks (Isaac Sim, ROS 2, imitation learning) might apply to Ruyi's industrial and commercial robot deployments.
intro_message: Shan, meet Prajyot Patil — she's an ML/Robotics engineer at Meta focused on sim-to-real pipelines and robot manipulation, and your work at Ruyi Dynamics on embodied AI deployment could benefit from her hands-on experience bridging simulation to real-world robot performance.
